title: Replacing leaking 250,000-gallon Haʻikū water tank
summary: Bill 149 passed first reading on October 10, 2025, with seven ayes. It would accept a $1,526,031 EPA grant for the Department of Water Supply to replace a water tank in Haʻikū. The 250,000-gallon tank can only be used at half capacity because of a leak in its upper half.

timeline.text: One grant would replace a deteriorated 250,000-gallon water tank in Haʻikū.
The council is adding federal EPA water grants to the fiscal year 2025 budget.
